messages:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY CHECK] Release v3.14.2 -> prod halted: configmap `kube-feature-flags` keys differ between staging and prod. staging has `ENABLE_FAST_KV_CACHE=true`; prod missing key -> chart default would enable it. recommending: pause rollout and investigate.
sam: pausing canary now. thanks. quick question — if it flips in prod, what's the user impact?
jess: ENABLE_FAST_KV_CACHE toggles the new in-memory KV cache. in staging we saw cost improvements but also occasional 15–30s tail latency on long-context requests. we intentionally had it on in staging to validate, but our tests missed edge cases.
oliver: if the chart default becomes true in prod (key absent -> default applied), we risk rolling the regression out cluster-wide. not acceptable.
anya: options: (A) rollback prod to v3.14.1, (B) patch prod configmap to explicitly set the flag false, (C) change chart values and re-deploy. fastest to reduce blast radius is patch configmap, but we should make it permanent in helm values.
kevin: can we patch then immediately apply a values PR? patch is temporary until next deployment if chart still lacks the key.
sam: decision: rollback prod to v3.14.1 to restore known-good, then submit a values PR that pins `featureFlags.enableFastKvCache: false` for prod and add a pre-release config parity check. schedule the re-deploy in the 02:00 UTC change window after CI validations.
jess: i'll open the values-pin PR and add a CI job that fails the release if `kube-feature-flags` lacks required prod keys.
anya: i'll run a hotfix patch so current pods don't flip mid-rollback. snippet i'll run:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap kube-feature-flags -p '{"data":{"ENABLE_FAST_KV_CACHE":"false"}}'
```
kevin: oncall notified. i'll keep an eye on latency SLI for the next 30m and watch for any unusual errors.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated by sam: `deploy rollback --env prod --to v3.14.1` — job queued -> started. canary remains paused.
oliver: also adding a short integration check in the release pipeline: compare `kube-feature-flags` keys between staging and prod before allowing canary to progress. prevents this class of drift.
jess: agreed, i'll add the check and link the PR here once ready.
sam: summary: hold rollout, rollback prod, pin flag in helm values, add CI parity check. follow-up PRs: values-pin (#4820) and ci-configmap-check (#4821) — will link when created. :thumbsup:
kevin: monitoring metrics now, will update if anything spikes.
